mapper.select: with maxdate as ( select MAX(t.EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE,t.CASH_ID from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE t where t.EFF_DATE <=to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by t.CASH_ID) select fccr.EFF_DATE, fccr.BASIS, fccr.YIELD, fcp.VDATE from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr inner join maxdate on maxdate.CASH_ID = fccr.CASH_ID and maxdate.EFF_DATE = fccr.EFF_DATE where fcp.CASH_ID = fccr.CASH_ID and fcp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fcp.VDATE <= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and fcp.MDATE > to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT AD.PROD_REGIST_CODE FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID
FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId} AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}

SELECT nvl(SUM(T.count),0) FROM (
SELECT nvl(count(TRADE_ID),0) count FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} UNION ALL
SELECT nvl(count(WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID),0) count FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID WHERE WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = #{tradeId} AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_OUT_TRADE = 'N' UNION ALL
SELECT nvl(count(WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID),0) count FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ON WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID WHERE FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.O_FINPROD_ID = #{tradeId} AND WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_OUT_TRADE = 'N')T
